{{Quote|We march up Vine Street, deploy into battle formation, and charge, sweeping the enemy before us like likkas.|Godking Trisstan|<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>}}
'''Vine Street''' was a street located in the largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]]'s northern continent. [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]] intended to march his warriors up Vine Street to engage [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] until he was persuaded not to by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]].<ref name="Godking" />
